gate: M10/2 Active; HAP GPU/app playback delivered; complete concurrency/shared/interoperability acceptance remains open
deliverable: HAP, HAP Alpha and HAP Q now play through MapGyver's native File workers and actual previews/Screen output, preserving compressed BC blocks through GPU upload. The existing publisher owns the same three slots, pending query, immutable stream, import and retirement path for HAP and decoder-pool frames.

ownership.gpu: GpuFramePublisher.new_hap admits one padded BC input texture, three visible RGBA bridge images and16 uniform bytes before source allocation. HapImage uploads BC1/BC3 blocks with the exact block-row pitch; GPU loads address visible texels, excluding padded odd edges. BC1 RGB forces alpha1 even in the three-color palette mode. BC3 RGBA preserves straight alpha; scaled-YCoCg BC3 reconstructs encoded RGB using the reference128/255 offset and encoded scale. Output remains the existing sRGB/straight-alpha GPU image contract.
ownership.reference: https://hap.video/developers and its linked reference YCoCg shader https://gist.github.com/dlublin/90f879cfe027ebf5792bdadf2c911bb5; no CPU BC/YCoCg pixel expansion or production readback is used.
ownership.decode_api: Decoder.open_native replaces the narrower open_d3d11 name without an alias: select D3D11 decoder frames or preserve HAP blocks for the selected GPU. DecodeStorage exposes the stable typed contract; callers do not parse codec labels. Existing explicit software open remains available for common-codec fallback.
ownership.file_worker: The same Reader, one in-flight conversion, transport epoch/cycle publication fence, exact step observations, revision wakes and cancellation lifecycle are reused. HAP source CPU admission covers current/next/upload block leases using conservative BC3 size plus16 MiB packet allowance, within the existing768 MiB shared CPU cap. Ordinary native decoding reserves the packet allowance. Existing measured GPU admission/carveout is unchanged.
ownership.recovery: A failed HAP native path withdraws and retries natively on the same authored binding/clock; it cannot silently use software RGBA. Common-codec native failures retain their explicit software fallback. Source GPU faults and slot releases keep the same wake/retirement semantics; publisher teardown drains actual completion or confirmed device removal. Combined driver-reset qualification remains required separately.

software.coverage: Full app/common/HAP codec regression, generated-contract equality and exact transport/history/caller tests pass. Final Golden suite includes new HAP zero-admission-before-device-work test and compilation of the ignored native color/alpha/retirement fixture.
software.strict: Combined app/Golden video-files/ffmpeg/qualification --lib --tests, default app and software-only Golden ffmpeg Clippy all pass with -D warnings. Default build initially exposed an unused HAP shader constant; shader emission is now correctly gated by ffmpeg before native execution.
software.ui_format: Embedded UI build succeeds; MapGyver Svelte check exits0 with zero errors/warnings. Browser syntax/Prettier pass. No product frontend/protocol DTO changes. Root and golden_core Cargo formatting and owned whitespace checks complete. Existing ts-rs serde-attribute notices remain unchanged.

native_gpu.hap: Both local GPUs pass all six actual frames of HAP/HAP Alpha/HAP Q through BC upload, GPU sampling/conversion, shared publication and renderer readback:36 images plus two BC1 opaque-palette checks. Independent sRGB/BC endpoint/YCoCg/straight-alpha oracle uses unchanged4/255 linear RGB and1/255 alpha budgets. Odd17x9 alpha storage, dropping caller frame before completion, withdrawal and admitted storage returning to zero pass.
native_gpu.regression: Existing both-GPU72 NV12/P010 range/transfer/luma cases, fixed-slot backpressure/held-completion retirement and six actual Intel H.264 GPU frames pass after the publisher refactor. Source-only format-interpretation rejections remain intact.

actual_app.script: apps/mapgyver/tests/browser/native-video-playback.mjs; exact selected adapter in an owned temporary profile; ten common/HAP profiles
actual_app.build: with-ffmpeg.ps1 rustc --locked -p MapGyver --features video-files --bin MapGyver -- -C extra-filename=-m10-hap: exit0
actual_app.coverage: Each HAP file passes actual Inspector File/defaults, Play/EOF hold, Stop,125ms seek, Undo/Redo, exact Next/Previous and Media Preview installed/available. Physical Screen output uses an independent BC/sRGB/alpha/YCoCg oracle with the unchanged4/255 linear budget. Backend events explicitly confirm HAP compressed GPU playback for each file on each GPU. Existing common-codec Reference/rate/loop/pause, mixed-rate hold, independent ProRes Composition copy, Matrix route and project reload regressions pass.
actual_app.limits: Short deterministic clips: not HAP multi-consumer/copy/project qualification, concurrent high-resolution playback, full chromatic/scale/external-encoder coverage, sustained performance or combined reset qualification. Media Preview installed/available is observed; physical panel scanout/cadence is not claimed. No desktop activation/input, monitor changes or driver reset.

remaining: Finish M10/2 with external-encoder/full-color/YCoCg-scale interoperability, concurrent high-resolution files, shared consumers and HAP-specific copy/routing/reload/retirement acceptance. Keep exactly M10/2 Active; no whole gate closes here.
